title: Gold Investment Vehicles: SGBs, Gold ETFs, and Digital Gold
source: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) & Tax Provisions
content: Gold provides portfolio diversification. 1. Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB): Issued by RBI, earns 2.5% p.a. fixed interest, 100% capital gains tax exemption if held till 8-year maturity. 2. Gold ETFs: High liquidity, transparent exchange pricing tracking domestic physical gold, stored in demat form. Gold asset allocation should typically range between 5% to 10% of total liquid net worth.
